page.content:
Dora the Explorer was a popular children's show that debuted in 2000. In 2004 LEGO manufactured Dora the Explorer Explore sets, but the theme was short lived and discontinued by the end of the year.

page.overview:
What is Dora the Explorer?

Dora the Explorer was a popular children's show that debuted in 2000. In 2004 LEGO manufactured Dora the Explorer Explore sets, but the theme was short lived and discontinued by the end of the year.
